safety.loto: Lock out and tag out the machine and release all stored energy before opening any guard, housing, line or filter.
extras: Oil above 50 °C can cause burns: let it cool before opening the oil circuit.
Stored air pressure can throw parts: vent the receiver and the separator completely.

oil_level.title: Oil level in the sight glass
oil_level.how: Read the level with the machine running at temperature.

oil_filter_dp.title: Oil filter differential pressure
oil_filter_dp.how: Read the differential gauge; compare with the nameplate limit.

cooler_fins.title: Cooler fin condition
cooler_fins.how: Open the cooler guard and inspect the fins with a lamp.

fan_motor.title: Cooling fan rotation and motor current
fan_motor.how: Watch the fan start and compare the motor current with the nameplate.

thermostatic_valve.title: Thermostatic valve operation
thermostatic_valve.how: Remove the valve and test it in a water bath.

intake_filter.title: Intake air filter indicator
intake_filter.how: Read the restriction indicator on the intake housing.

separator_dp.title: Air/oil separator differential pressure
separator_dp.how: Read the differential gauge across the separator.

inlet_valve.title: Inlet valve opening at load
inlet_valve.how: Check that the valve opens fully when the machine loads.

leak_check.title: Downstream air leak check
leak_check.how: Soap-test fittings and hoses downstream of the machine while it runs.

causes.label: Cooler fins clogged with dust
causes.fix: Clean the cooler with dry air and a gentle wash; fit a pre-filter on the air inlet of the room.

causes.label: Cooling fan or fan motor failure
causes.fix: Replace the fan motor or its capacitor and check the rotation direction.

causes.label: Thermostatic valve stuck closed
causes.fix: Replace the thermostatic element and refill the oil.

causes.label: Oil level too low
causes.fix: Top up with the specified oil and find the leak.

causes.label: Oil filter clogged
causes.fix: Replace the oil filter and the oil if it is past its interval.

causes.label: Intake air filter clogged
causes.fix: Replace the intake filter element.

causes.label: Air/oil separator clogged
causes.fix: Replace the air/oil separator and the oil filter.

causes.label: Inlet valve not opening fully
causes.fix: Overhaul or replace the inlet valve.

causes.label: Air leak downstream of the machine
causes.fix: Repair the leaking fitting or hose.

safety.loto: Lock out and tag out the machine and release all stored energy before opening any guard, housing, line or filter.
extras: Release the pressure and drain the casing before opening it; the liquid may be hot.

suction_valve.title: Suction valve position
suction_valve.how: Confirm the valve is fully open and the handle matches the stem.

strainer.title: Suction strainer condition
strainer.how: Close the valves, drain and open the strainer basket.

seal_inspect.title: Mechanical seal and gland
seal_inspect.how: Inspect the seal faces and look for dripping at the gland.

motor_rotation.title: Motor rotation direction and current
motor_rotation.how: Compare the rotation with the arrow on the casing and read the current.

vibration.title: Bearing vibration reading
vibration.how: Measure at both bearings with the vibration pen.

discharge_pressure.title: Discharge pressure against the pump curve
discharge_pressure.how: Read the discharge gauge at the current flow and compare with the curve.

impeller_inspect.title: Impeller wear
impeller_inspect.how: Open the casing and inspect the impeller and wear ring.

alignment_check.title: Coupling alignment
alignment_check.how: Check the alignment with a dial indicator or laser tool.

causes.label: Suction valve partly closed
causes.fix: Open the valve fully and lock it in position.

causes.label: Suction strainer clogged
causes.fix: Clean the strainer and find where the debris comes from.

causes.label: Impeller worn
causes.fix: Replace the impeller and the wear ring.

causes.label: Motor running in the wrong direction
causes.fix: Swap two phases and confirm the rotation.

causes.label: Bearing worn
causes.fix: Replace both bearings and check the shaft.

causes.label: Coupling misaligned
causes.fix: Realign the coupling to the manufacturer's tolerance.

causes.label: Cavitation from a blocked suction
causes.fix: Clear the suction strainer and check the NPSH margin.

safety.loto: Lock out and tag out the machine and release all stored energy before opening any guard, housing, line or filter.
extras: Lower the ram onto blocks and release hydraulic pressure before opening any hydraulic line.

tank_level.title: Hydraulic tank level
tank_level.how: Read the level gauge with the ram retracted.

return_filter.title: Return filter indicator
return_filter.how: Read the clogging indicator while the pump runs.

pump_pressure.title: Pump pressure at the relief setting
pump_pressure.how: Dead-head the pump briefly and read the gauge.

relief_valve.title: Relief valve setting
relief_valve.how: Remove the relief valve and bench-test it.

cylinder_seal.title: Cylinder seal leakage
cylinder_seal.how: Block the ram, pressurise one side and watch for drift or leakage.

causes.label: Tank level too low
causes.fix: Top up with the specified oil and find the leak.

causes.label: Return filter clogged
causes.fix: Replace the return filter element.

causes.label: Hydraulic pump worn
causes.fix: Overhaul or replace the pump.

causes.label: Relief valve opening too early
causes.fix: Reset or replace the relief valve.

causes.label: Cylinder seal leaking internally
causes.fix: Replace the cylinder seals.
